scoring_justification: Raman frequencies are the direct output of the implemented model; recompute from the agent’s raw artifacts (e.g., fitted_params.json) would require parsing a file not declared as a scored output and whose format is not guaranteed. Comparing the reported values to the paper’s published reference with an appropriate tolerance is sufficient and was the planned verification method.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported principal Raman frequencies for CaF₂, SrF₂, BaF₂ at 298 K (Table 1 Present row).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1; values 314.7, 284.9, 247.2 cm⁻¹ for CaF₂, SrF₂, BaF₂ respectively.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied directly from the paper’s published numerical results; they are the authoritative target for reproduction under the Lundqvist potential with TPP and TBI.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual paper-reported results for the same model and conditions; no fabrication is needed. The values are well-known and publicly available but hidden for scoring purposes.

outputs.description: Principal Raman frequencies (in cm⁻¹) for CaF2, SrF2, and BaF2 at 298 K computed with the Lundqvist potential including three-body interactions and thermal phonon pressure.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the three values against hidden reference values with an absolute tolerance. The fitting procedure must be executed by the agent; no pre-fitted parameters are provided.
